title: Munition Chest Key
summary: Opens the heavy chest near the main entrance to the Requisitioned Barn.

fields.Acquisition: Carried by Fist Poole. DC 18 Sleight of Hand is an alternative. The chest holds Potion of Superior Healing, Remedial Potion, Elixir of Heroism and Longsword +1.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
